内容切入：观赛家庭 / 亲子场景，CTA 主打「家庭优先购买资格」。角度取深度价: Content angle: families watching the event / parent-child scenarios, with the CTA leading on "family-first purchasing eligibility". Take the deep-value / data-comparison / long-termism angle and keep the tone rational, restrained and report-like. Never use "low price / limited time / group buy / flash sale / only N left". Visuals use generous white space plus premium real-world imagery, with a single restrained CTA. Once a contact registers, promotions stop and the follow-up switches to service confirmation.
内容切入：氛围与稀缺感（决赛唯一候选 / 优先资格），弱化条款、强化「第一时间拿: Content angle: atmosphere and scarcity (the only candidate for the final / priority eligibility), playing down the fine print and pushing "be first to secure your spot". The tone is casual and spoken — short sentences, emoji allowed — and cites UGC and limited-quantity information. Visuals use high-saturation clashing colours and close-up portraits, and the CTA leans on verbs like "grab / tap now / save me one". Single-wave reach stays within this package's frequency cap and quiet hours.
内容切入：「带孩子看决赛」的价值主张 + 确定性信息。合规口径：日期 / 场馆在: Content angle: the value proposition of "taking the kids to the final", backed by concrete certainty messaging. Compliance line: the date and venue must not be written up as confirmed before the host officially announces them. Keep the tone warm and specific, guide-style, foregrounding safety details and real family cases. Visuals use warm-toned cards plus genuine family photos, and the CTA points to the family-friendly itinerary / safety assurances.
内容切入：Hospitality 包厢 / 企业观赛权益，收入档 L4/L5。语: Content angle: hospitality boxes / corporate viewing entitlements, for income bands L4/L5. The tone is businesslike and concise, presenting entitlements and the agenda in table form and showing real corporate logos, with a CTA of "get a group-buy proposal / contact the corporate advisor". It works better as a handover to an account manager than as pure email reach.
内容切入：以外部权威事件（host 确认）或新权益作为重启理由，避免「纯提醒式」: Content angle: use an external authoritative event (confirmed by the host) or a new entitlement as the reason to come back, avoiding a "pure reminder" style reactivation. Keep the tone nostalgic and conversational, like a note from a friend: mention one brand-new change and never stack up discounts. Visuals use low-saturation retro tones and shots from behind. Contacts who still show no interaction go to the suppression list / list cleaning, with no extra frequency added.
